units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 75b:11">B. Mets. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>גורם ק׳ לעצמו</he> brings dishonor upon himself (people believing him to be dishonest).
<cite ref="Megillah 15a:18">Meg. 15ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אל תהי קִלְלַת הדיוט וכ׳</he> let not the curse of a common man be a slight thing in thy eyes.
<cite ref="Megillah 28a:6">Ib. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>לא עלתה … קללת חבירי</he> the thought of my neighbor’s curse never went to bed with me (v. <cite ref="R00664"><he>צְעַר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Yoma 54b:1">Yoma 54ᵇ</cite> <he>חללו … וקִלְלָתָן ק׳ וכ׳</he> those whose blessing is blessing, and whose curse is curse (whose blessings and curses are efficacious) are engaged in such things!—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:8:7">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>קיללת השם</he> (usu. <cite ref="B01296"><he>ברכת</he></cite>) blasphemy.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:8:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מהו לקרוע על קיללת הגוי</he> how about rending one’s garments on hearing blasphemy by a gentile?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְלָלוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Megillah 31b:8">Meg. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ שבתורת כהנים</he> the curses in Leviticus (XXVI, 14-43); <he>שבמשנה תורה</he> the curses in Deuteronomy (XXVIII, 15-68). Ib. <he>שתכלה השנה וקִלְלוֹתֶיהָ</he> that the year and its curses my end together.
<cite ref="Eruvin 100b:20">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>עשר ק׳ וכ׳</he> Eve was cursed with ten curses; a. fr.
